Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Let's Verify Step by Step (arXiv 2305.20050v1) · paper method: The study evaluates reward models by best-of-N selection from a fixed generator and deliberately does not improve that generator with reinforcement learning.

cohort2.claim.process.fixed-generator-scope

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific paper report; no experiment or dataset record inspection was reproduced by this author.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Let's Verify Step by Step (arXiv 2305.20050v1) · paper method: Large-scale PRM and ORM training sets are not directly comparable: active PRM selection biases toward wrong answers and uses an order of magnitude fewer examples; small-scale ablations use model-generated supervision on matched data.
